native.method: StructureTemplate.placeInWorld in isolated Forge GameTest server

scope.test_world: qa/forge-runtime/world (new isolated disposable QA world only)

limits: No modpack-client screenshot, player-world placement, hall integration, FPS or multiplayer test
The ten side-cell doors are closed decoration, not a functional prison gameplay system
Orange glow is safely simulated by covered shroomlight, not fluid lava
native_log_notes: The first isolated startup creates its own config and server.properties; missing-file startup messages are retained in the raw log.
The GameTest log warns that a spawned server was temporarily behind schedule; this is not a client FPS/performance measurement.
Forge/Gradle deprecation notices and renderer default-pack warnings do not replace the required test-pass assertions.
